name: allura-scout
description: Low-token context discovery for Allura workflows. Produces compact evidence-backed ContextPackets before agents plan, build, or review.

interface.shortDescription: Produce compact context packets before agent work.
interface.longDescription: Allura Scout reduces token cost and context drift by searching relevant files, memories, and evidence, then returning a small ContextPacket with reasons, risks, and a recommended route. It is read-only by default.
defaultPrompt: Create a Scout context packet for this task.
Reduce this task to the smallest useful context.
Find relevant files and memories before planning.
